decision.observation: 10:50 pm, rain. The camera shows a graveyard with headstones north of a low fence, and the farmer is hidden behind the toolbar in a bush-lined lower path; clock frozen, so west was blocked.
decision.hypothesis: The town's main east-west road lies just north of the graveyard; heading north onto it then west leads back toward the bus stop and the farm.
decision.memory: Town graveyard is south of the main road; the road west leads to the bus stop corridor and farm. Introductions 7/28; 450g; half energy.
